findings.title: F7 code-manifest expansion is real but incomplete: production-reachable iq_ref.rs and cpu_dot_tables.rs remain unenumerated while test-only iq.rs is enumerated, and the cycle-02 validation mapping overstates coverage as 'all reachable quant source modules'
findings.evidence: The regenerated code manifest binds crates/f017-runner/src/json.rs (duplicate-key parser, verified reachable via load_unique_json) and quant lib.rs/cpu_dot.rs/q6_k_ref.rs/q8_0_ref.rs/iq.rs. However decode_iq2_xxs_matrix/decode_iq3_xxs_matrix live in crates/quant/src/iq_ref.rs and depend on the IQ2XXS/IQ3XXS codebook grids in crates/quant/src/cpu_dot_tables.rs; both are reachable from the executor's decode() for 24 of the 40 census tensors and neither is in the code manifest, while the enumerated iq.rs encoder module is reached from cpu_dot.rs only inside #[cfg(test)]. The cycle-02 validation finding_to_fix_mapping for F7 therefore overstates completeness.
findings.required_action: At the next code-manifest generation, enumerate crates/quant/src/iq_ref.rs and crates/quant/src/cpu_dot_tables.rs (and drop or keep iq.rs explicitly as non-production), and correct the mapping wording; no regeneration is required before the readiness phase for this reason alone.
findings.disposition: DOES_NOT_WEAKEN: iq_ref.rs is independently hash-bound by the release-bound decoder-bindings contract (recomputed this review: c1606b39... matches committed bytes), and both files are covered by two whole-identity pins the wrapper verifies before any spawn - executor_sha256 (whole-binary, recomputed matching fe82ab79...) and execution_code_head (whole-commit source identity) - so any drift in either source fails EXECUTOR_SHA before arithmetic; the gap is provenance-enumeration completeness plus one overstated word in banked evidence, not an open numerical or execution path, and is strictly narrower than the cycle-1 F7 state already adjudicated non-weakening.

findings.title: Executor does not cross-check package fixed_attempt_root/fixed_capture_root against the release machine_local_paths; a root-divergent operator package burns the single attempt (durably terminalized, never a false PASS)
findings.evidence: validate_package requires the two roots only to be absolute. The binding that closes the attempt root is behavioral: the executor open_onces owner.json at package.fixed_attempt_root against the wrapper-supplied owner sha, and the wrapper created owner.json only at the release attempt_root, so ordinary divergence fails INPUT_STAT and terminalizes as an owned RUNNER_EXIT failure; a capture-root-divergent package would complete capture at the wrong root and then fail wrapper success-validation (CAPTURE_MANIFEST), which the BaseException handler converts to a durable owned TERMINAL_FAILURE. Both paths consume the attempt but neither can yield an unterminalized root or a false success.
findings.required_action: At the pre-approval readiness/package-review gate, verify byte-for-byte that the authored package's fixed_attempt_root, fixed_capture_root, and manifest path equal the release machine_local_paths before any approval is issued; optionally pin the exact roots in a future package-schema/executable generation.
findings.disposition: DOES_NOT_WEAKEN: every divergence path fails closed with durable owned terminalization and operator adjudication, the package does not exist yet (package_created false, live_package_manifest false), and the release chain already routes package review through the human-gated readiness phase where this check belongs; capture observability, accounting, and gate ordering are unaffected.

findings.title: Adjudication of carried F8: compiler/Metal underspecification remains resolved by pinned implementation identity plus a mandatory unexecuted 10-run byte-determinism gate; no portability or equivalence result is claimed or claimable from this surface
findings.evidence: MLX matvec reduction/contraction order and Rust f32 libm transcendentals (powf/sin/cos/exp/sqrt) remain implementation-defined. The surface resolves them by declared exact-implementation authority: all five MLX dylib/header hashes recomputed on this machine and matching the runtime binding and the executable's hardcoded constants; macOS 26.0/25A354, Metal 32023.864, clang 1700.6.4.2, rustc 1.97.1 pinned; inline(never) single-rounding scalar helpers with serial left folds; thread limits pinned to 1; the determinism contract requires ten fresh-process byte-identical runs of all 34 stage files on the pinned environment before any equivalence claim (executed: false, repetitions: 10, cross_hardware_portability NOT_CLAIMED, production_comparisons 0); numerical equivalence is deferred to the separately frozen tolerance contract. With rope_base now bit-pinned end to end (F2 closed), no load-bearing numeric constant remains outside this declared resolution.
findings.required_action: None beyond executing the already-frozen 10-run byte-identity qualification and the frozen-tolerance comparison at the human-gated execution phase; any residual Metal scheduling nondeterminism fails that gate rather than passing silently.
findings.disposition: DOES_NOT_WEAKEN: the underspecification is openly declared, bounded to the recomputed pinned environment, and backstopped by fail-closed byte-identity and tolerance gates; this review confirms no portability or equivalence result is asserted anywhere in the banked cycle-2 evidence.

finding_to_fix_mappings.detail: Wrapper attempt-start now binds environment_identity to the existing hash-verified release runtime_binding field; all post-owner work is enclosed in an owned BaseException terminalization that writes a durable no-retry TERMINAL_FAILURE plus artifact inventory before re-raising, empirically confirmed by re-injecting the exact prior defect class (missing release key after owner creation) against temp paths; pre-owner failures create no attempt root; retry refused ATTEMPT_ALREADY_EXISTS_NO_RETRY; and the new committed synthetic execute test was proven regression-sensitive by mutating a temp wrapper copy back to release["runtime_identity"] and observing the test fail with that exact KeyError.

rope_base f32 1000000.0 is bit-pinned in all five required authorities: graph guard inputs.rope_base.to_bits() != 1_000_000.0_f32.to_bits() in apple_serial_f32.rs, identical to_bits gate in the executable validate_package, package-schema fixed_graph rope_base_f32, stage-manifest query_heads numeric_constants, and three validator checks (source text, stage contract, package contract).

The Q4_K decode arm is removed from the executable decode(); exactly six reachable formats remain (F32_LE, Q5_K, Q6_K, Q8_0, IQ2_XXS, IQ3_XXS) matching the decoder-bindings contract (all six implementation hashes recomputed) and the corrected specification text; validator enforces the six-format census.

Wrapper validate_release now rehashes the runtime-binding contract, then the five installed MLX dylib/header identities at their machine paths, all eight bound_contracts, all 21 code-manifest artifacts, the authorization schema, and the executor before any authority; confirmed by source audit and by the passing preflight run on this machine; residual within-invocation TOCTOU between preflight hashing and spawn is inherent to a single-process gate and bounded to seconds inside the owned invocation.

validate_capture now pins the exact ordered canonical 34-stage census per ordinal (CAPTURE_STAGE_ORDER) and rejects any unmanifested or missing capture-root entry via exact directory-set equality (CAPTURE_UNMANIFESTED_OR_MISSING_FILE); both empirically confirmed by synthetic order-swap and extra-file attacks; the wrapper Python census is byte-identical to the Rust, stage-manifest, and capture-contract censuses.

run_apple_serial_f32 now calls DenseMatrix::validate on all 24 routed expert matrices and all 3 shared expert matrices in addition to the seven attention/router matrices, giving library-level values-length and finiteness parity for every graph matrix.

The duplicate-key parser json.rs is now enumerated and hash-bound, and the quant crate is substantially enumerated (lib.rs, cpu_dot.rs, q6_k_ref.rs, q8_0_ref.rs, iq.rs); however production-reachable iq_ref.rs and cpu_dot_tables.rs remain outside the code manifest and the validation mapping's 'all reachable quant source modules' overstates coverage; tracked as cycle-2 finding 02-F1 with a concrete non-weakening disposition (decoder-bindings hash for iq_ref.rs plus executor_sha256 and execution_code_head whole-identity pins close every drift path before spawn).

Adjudicated as cycle-2 finding 02-F3: pinned implementation identity recomputed and matching, mandatory unexecuted 10-run byte-determinism gate stands between this surface and any equivalence claim, and no portability or equivalence result is claimed anywhere in the banked evidence.
